Commentary.Commentary: That leaves us at an interesting stage. Still early in the series, New Zealand can easily pull back but they will need to step up with their performance. India have performed very confidently and will be keen to carry on their winning momentum. The two sides will meet again at 1330 IST on the 20th of October in Delhi. Until then, goodbye and take care!

Hardik Pandya is the Man of the match for his brilliant spell of bowling. Begins by saying that it was special to do well on his debut. Calls it a pleasure to receive the ODI cap from Kapil Dev. Adds that he bowled a lot in the A tour of Australia and that has helped him. Mentions that he was not concentrating on bowling fast but wanted to keep things simple.

MS Dhoni calls it a fantastic performance from the fast bowlers, says that they bowled the perfect length today and he credits Pandya for bowling in the right areas. Credits Kohli as well for batting well and to the openers for giving a good start. Calls Hardik a deceptive bowler and that is what helped him too. Adds that once Southee started hitting, the spinners were under pressure but they bowled well. Confesses that chasing 280-300 would have been difficult. Admits that it was good for him to get some time in the middle. Mentions that it is important to win early in the series. Feels that winning the toss could be crucial in the series.

Kane Williamson begins by stating that they had to weather the storm with the bat and the first ten overs were tough for them. Admits there were plenty of soft dismissals. Credits India for exploiting the conditions well and they could not take the game deep since they lost too many wickets inside the first ten overs. Adds that they hoped to take new ball wickets but credits India for showing how good a chasing side they are. Confesses they were below par and wants his team to be at their best to beat a team like India.

Earlier in the day, the Kiwis were put out to bat first and were nearly brought to their knees early on by Yadav and Pandya. With the score at 65/7, they recovered enough to put up a total of 190, thanks in part to the ineffectiveness of the spinners. Surprisingly, the man responsible for their last-minute runs was Southee, who scored a quick fifty. Opener Latham, scoring 79, hung in for the entire innings, a feat only 10 batsmen have done in ODIs. Unfortunately, he couldn't find enough partners to support him and Mishra wrapped up the tail-enders.

New Zealand had a below-par total to defend and knew that it wouldn't be an easy ride. They came in looking for early wickets and once Bracewell got the breakthrough with Sharma, Neesham quickly followed it up with fellow opener Rahane's scalp. However, they weren't able to push their advantage and kept conceding runs. The Black Caps managed to pick up a couple more wickets but it was a case of too little too late for the visitors.

India were in complete control for nearly the entire duration of the match. The run chase pounded forward, inexorably eating into the target. Openers Sharma and Rahane got them off to a good start and Dhoni and Kohli put them within touching distance of the finish line. Pandey and Jadhav made valuable contributions as well to keep the scoreboard ticking throughout while Kohli was in his element, bringing up a finely wrought 85.
Smooth sailing for India! This is the 900th ODI match for the hosts and they have won it in commanding fashion with 6 wickets and 16.5 overs to spare.
SIX! INDIA WIN BY 6 WICKETS! Bowled around off and middle, Kohli slinks down and smashes it over the head of the bowler for a maximum to seal the game and take a 1-0 lead in the 5-match ODI series.
Landed outside off, driven to covers by Jadhav.
Floated outside off, Jadhav looks to defend but is beaten.
FOUR! Put away! Shorter on middle, Jadhav gets on top of it and crashes it over mid-wicket for a boundary. India just three runs away!
Landed around outside off, Jadhav pushes it to covers.
Turns it towards the on side off his crease.

Oh..was that out? Shorter outside off, Jadhav looks to cut that one but does not connect well. The keeper collects and he along with the bowler think it is out and they do not even care to appeal. That was in fact out. Unlucky New Zealand!
Shorter on off, Kohli goes back and punches it through mid on.
Fuller outside off, Kohli drives it to sweeper cover. The second run is on and Sodhi the bowler breaks the stumps with his hands without collecting the ball.
Jadhav turns it towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! EDGED! Floated outside off, Jadhav comes forward to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and runs down to the third man fence.
Kohli plays this one through mid off for a single.
FOUR! HIT AWAY! Fuller outside off, Kohli comes forward and spanks it through covers for a boundary. That was superbly done by Kohli.
Sodhi is back on.
Driven through mid off for a single to keep the strike. 19 runs needed in as many overs.
Kohli comes forward and plays it back down the wicket where the bowler stops the ball in his followthrough.
Loopy on off, Kohli is right forward and blocks it to covers.
Landed outside off, Jadhav drives it hard through covers for a single to get off the mark.
Floated on off, Kedar comes forward and defends it.
Kohli drives this fuller one down to long on for a single.
Full outside off, Kohli drives it hard but straight to deep cover for a single.
Kohli drives it towards mid on but not in the gap.
FOUR! Superbly timed! Slower one and fuller outside off, Kohli comes forward and creams it through covers. Santner again has a lot of work to do but this time he allows the ball to go through.
Fuller again on off, Kohli plays it towards mid on off his crease. The bat actually turned in his hands a bit.
Fuller outside off, Kohli gets across and defends it towards mid off.
Fuller outside off, Kohli comes forward and drives it through covers. Santner stops the ball at the fence and keeps them down to a couple.
Neesham back in the attack.
Jadhav stands in his crease and pushes it to covers.
Shorter on off, Jadhav works it towards square leg off his crease.
Kedar Jadhav is the new man in.
Drinks break...

OUT! RUN OUT! MIX-UP AND DHONI DEPARTS! Floated on off, Dhoni comes down looking to hit it towards mid-wicket but misses. The ball goes off the pads towards covers. Slight hesitation between Dhoni and Kohli but that gives Guptill enough time to return the throw to the keeper Ronchi who takes the bails off in a flash. Kohli is not happy about it, his reaction for the run at first meant Dhoni was haring down for the single. India need only 29 more runs though.
Fuller outside off, Dhoni comes down to hit it to mid off but the bowler fields it.
Shorter outside off, Kohli goes back and cuts it through point for a single.
Floated outside off, Dhoni lunges forward and pushes through covers for a single.
Fuller outside off, Kohli comes forward and defends it towards mid off.
Flicks this one through square leg for a couple of runs.
Good length on off, Kohli stands his crease and defends it.
DROPPED! Bowls it full on off, Kohli is early into his drive and ends up playing it back to Southee. The ball comes quickly to Southee who is not quite in position to take it.
FOUR! Cheeky  from Virat! Shorter length outside off, Kohli waits for it and waits for the ball at the last moment to glide it over the keeper for a boundary.
50-run partnership between Virat Kohli and MS Dhoni.
FOUR! Fetch that! Shorter length outside off, Kohli pulls it hard through mid-wicket for a boundary. That was nicely controlled.
Floated on off, Dhoni comes down to work it through mid-wicket but is hit on his pads. The ball rolls towards mid-wicket.
Fuller on off, Kohli comes forward and drives it through mid off for a single.
Short on off, Kohli works it towards mid-wicket off his back foot.
Short on off, Dhoni stands tall and punches it through covers for a single.
Kohli drives this one through mid on for a single.
Flatter on middle, played back to the bowler by Kohli.
Good running! Dhoni taps this one towards covers. They take a single.  The fielder is a touch slow to react and that gives Dhoni enough time to comeback for a second.
37th ODI fifty for Virat Kohli.
FIFTY! A tad short outside off, Kohli punches it through covers for a single. That also brings up his fifty. It has been a routine knock in the chase.
On a length outside off, Kohli taps it towards point.
On a length on off, Kohli gets across and clips it nicely to mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
A good length delivery on off, Dhoni tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Vintage MS! A touch short outside off, Dhoni stands tall and slams it through point for a boundary. That was hit like a bullet and raced away to the fence.
Kohli has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On middle, driven to mid on.
Shortish ball on middle, Kohli waits for it and punches it to the leg side.
Fuller ball on off, flicked through the leg side for a single.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
On the stumps, played through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! MASSIVE! Short ball outside off, Dhoni squares his shoulders and heaves at it. That ball takes a top edge and goes over fine leg and into the stands for a maximum.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.
Fullish ball outside off, punched to the covers.
Wide down the leg side, Dhoni leaves it alone. The Umpire signals a wide.
Good length ball on off, defended off the back foot to point.
Shortish ball outside off, guided to backward point for a single.
FOUR! Balance and control! Full on the pads, Kohli goes back and flicks it to mid on. Anderson tries to stop it but the ball gets past and crosses the ropes. India is in cruise control now.
Short ball outside off, Kohli cuts it through the covers for a single to keep the strike. 68 runs needed off 162 balls.
Landed on the stumps, played to mid-wicket for a single.
Served around off, pushed off the front foot through mid off for a single.
Kohli meets that tossed up ball with a solid front foot defence.
Tossed up on the stump, nudged to square leg for a single.
Loopy ball outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
Mitchell Santner to roll his arm.
Length ball on the stumps, defended back to the bowler.
Back of a length ball around off, clipped through the leg side for a single.
Full ball outside off, driven to the covers.
Slower delivery, in the corridor outside off, Dhoni leaves it.
MSD shoulders arms to let that one through.
Fullish ball outside off, Dhoni looks to play it to the covers but mistimes it back to the bowler.
Neesham comes back on.
Back of a length ball outside off, played to point.
FOUR! How well placed was that?! Full outside off, Kohli drives it through the covers. He has picked the gap just right and the ball goes through for a boundary.
FOUR! Unlucky for Bracewell! Full on off, Kohli drives it straight back to Bracewell, who sticks a foot out to stop it but ends up deflecting it wide of the mid on fielder for a boundary.
Back of a length ball on middle, flicked to mid-wicket. Some excellent running between the wickets and the batsmen get a couple.
Kohli defends it from within the crease.
Full ball outside off, Dhoni charges down the track and drives it to extra cover. The fielder goes for a throw at the non-striker's end but the batsman is well in.
Doug Bracewell returns for a bowl.
Kohli gets forward and drives it hard through covers. The fielder in the deep, Santner dives and makes a good stop. Two runs taken.
Flatter on middle, Kohli gets across and clips it down to fine leg fence for a couple.
Floated on middle, Dhoni walks down and turns it through mid on for a single. Dhoni gets off the mark.
MS Dhoni walks in to bat at Number 5!

OUT! CAUGHT! Short ball on middle, Pandey can't resist this one and pulls it. That was a poor shot and the ball goes straight to Kane Williamson at short mid-wicket. He takes a comfortable catch and New Zealand finally  get the breakthrough they have been waiting for. That wasn't quite a convincing shot from Pandey.
Tossed up on off, driven to the covers for a single.
Full and wide outside off, slashed through the covers for a single.
Fullish ball on the stumps, firmly flicked through mid-wicket for a brace.
Length ball outside off, defended to the off side.
Back of a length ball outside off, left alone.
Shot! Shortish ball outside off, Pandey ducks a bit and pulls it through mid-wicket.  A couple of fielders give chase and arrest it moments before the boundary. The batsmen pick up a triple.
Fuller ball outside off, pushed through the covers for a couple.
Fullish in length around off, defended off the back foot and back to the bowler.
Wide! Down the leg side, Pandey considers going after it but leaves it. The umpire spreads his arms and signals a wide.
Fuller outside off, played through deep cover for a single.
Drags this short on middle, Kohli punches it through mid on for a single.
Floated outside off, Kohli mistimes his drive towards covers.
Full again outside off, Kohli drives it nicely through covers. Kohli wants the second one and Pandey dives to get into his crease.
Fuller outside off, driven nicely to deep cover for a single.
Floated on off, Pandey drives it to covers.
Fullish ball outside off, pushed to point.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Short ball on off, Pandey pulls it somewhat awkwardly through mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball outside off, helped to third man for a single.
Shortish ball outside off, punched off the back foot to the fielder at deep extra cover for a single.
Back of a length ball on middle and off, well defended back to the bowler.
Shorter outside off, Pandey goes back and punches it through covers for a single.
Landed outside off, Pandey opens the face of the bat and pushes it to covers.
Around off, Kohli drives it to sweeper cover for a run.
Bowls it very full on off, Manish drives it down to long off for a single.
Kohli leans forward and drives this fuller one through mid off for a single.
Starts off with a shorter one outside off, Kohli goes back and punches it to mid off and the ball is recovered by the bowler.
Ish Sodhi comes into the attack.
DRINKS BREAK!
Pandey picked that bouncer early and let it through to the keeper.
Close call for Pandey! Shortish ball outside off, he frees his arms looking to slash at it but misses and the keeper catches it. An appeal goes up for a caught behind only to be quickly stifled.
Back of a length ball on leg, worked behind square leg for a single.
Fuller ball on middle, defended back to the bowler.

Well fielded! Shortish ball outside off, cut hard through the covers. Corey Anderson runs to his left in the deep and makes a great dive to stop the boundary. The batsmen manage to come back for the second.
Length ball outside off, pushed to point.
Tim Southee is back on.
Length ball outside off, Virat opens the face of his bat and guides it to third man for a single.
Well controlled! Back of a length ball around off, pulled through mid-wicket for a couple.
Length ball on middle and off, nudged down to backward square leg for a single.
Bouncer! On the stumps, Pandey ducks to avoid it. The umpire signals a wide.
Kohli works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Precision! Angled onto the pads, Kohli flicks it through mid-wicket. That was timed excellently and goes across the ropes.
Full ball outside off, Kohli looks to drive it but inside edges it onto his pads and the ball goes to the covers.
In the corridor outside off, Manish decides to let it through.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.
FOUR! Short ball outside off, Pandey reaches across and lofts it over the covers. The fielder jumps up to catch it but the ball goes over for a boundary.
The ball is too wide on the off side for Pandey to make any contact.

Shortish ball outside off, defended off the back foot to point.
Bouncer! Kohli ducks well in time to evade it.
Fuller ball outside off, solidly pushed to the covers.
Length delivery around off, worked down the leg side.
Full ball on off, driven back to the bowler.
Good length ball outside off, Kohli shoulders arms to let that one through.
Back of a length ball outside off, Rahane defends it with soft hands to point. Not a good over for Neesham.
Length ball outside off, guided to third man for a single.
FOUR! Well struck! Full in length, Kohli drives it through the covers for a boundary. That is some shot from Kohli to get off the mark!
Kohli defends it from within the crease.
Fullish ball down leg, Rahane looks to flick but misses and the ball hits his pads. The umpire signals a leg bye.
Length ball outside off, pushed to point.
Wide! Three wides it a row! This time it is  too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
Wide! Down the leg side, and Rahane leaves it. The umpire has signalled a wide again.
FIVE WIDES! A costly mistake by Neesham. Wide down the leg side, Rahane leaves it. Ronchi dives to his left but the ball is too wide and goes to the fine leg boundary.
The second Powerplay is signalled.
Kohli chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
EDGED! Good length ball around off, Kohli looks to defend it off the front foot but the ball takes an inside edge and smacks into his pads. A brief appeal goes up but is quickly silenced.

Fuller ball outside off, pushed to mid off.
Fullish ball on middle and off, flicked to the leg side for a single.

Length ball on the stumps, Sharma clips it and the ball goes to the fielder at mid-wicket on one bounce.
Back of a length ball outside off, Rahane edges it to third man for a single.
Full and wide outside off, Rahane reaches across but mistimes his drive to cover-point.
Inside edged! Length ball outside off, Rahane looks to defend it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Shortish ball outside off, a little extra bounce and Rahane leaves it.
Jimmy Neesham comes into the attack for the first time!
Full around off, driven to mid off.
BEATEN! Back of a length ball outside off, Sharma goes on the back foot to defend it but the ball holds its line and beats his bat's outside edge.
Length ball on middle and off, clipped to mid-wicket for a couple.
Fuller ball outside off, defended off the front foot to the off side.
Fullish ball around off, Sharma stays back in the crease and blocks it with the full face of the bat.
Length ball on middle, worked to square leg.
Full around off, Rahane mistimes his drive and the ball goes to the man at mid on.
FOUR! Full ball outside off, Rahane drives and places it to perfection. Once more, Williamson comes running from mid off but can't stop it in time and the ball hits the fence.
Full ball on off, driven to mid on.
Length ball outside off, Rahane helps it to third man.
Very full delivery on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket for a brace.
Length ball outside off, Rohit guides it to third man for a single.
SIX! High and mighty! Rahane does it again! Another short ball on the stumps and Rahane punishes it with a pull that sends it flying over square leg for a big one.
Shortish ball outside off, defended to point.
Fuller ball outside off, driven to mid off.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
SIX! Rahane goes on the attack now! Short ball on middle and leg, Rahane flat bats it and the ball goes over the boundary at fine leg for a maximum.
Fullish ball outside off, Rahane plays it off the front foot to mid off.
In the corridor outside off, easily left by Sharma.

Well bowled! Length ball on the stumps, Rahane goes for a front foot defence but misses and is struck high on the thigh pad. There is a big appeal for lbw but the umpire isn't impressed.

BEATEN! Short ball outside off, Rahane goes for the pull but misses and the ball goes to the keeper.
Rahane has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Back of a length ball outside off, Rahane stands tall and plays it to third man for a single.

Fuller ball on middle and off, flicked to mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, pushed to point.

Fullish ball with a bit of width on off, Rahane steps across and defends it.

In the corridor outside off, Rohit Sharma shoulders his arms.

Welcome back for the chase! 191 to win for India. The two openers Rohit Sharma and Ajinkya Rahane are out to bat for India. Tim Southee to start the bowling proceedings with three slips in place. Here we go...
